basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old music teacher based in Salt Lake City, Utah. I have a deep passion for video games, especially the Borderlands series, which I play during my free time. Music is my profession and therapy, and I love sharing my knowledge with students. I enjoy exploring different cultural and spiritual perspectives, which led me to participate in subreddits like SLVTakeOver and latterdaysaints. I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM MST, once I've wrapped up my classes and personal practice. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people through online communities, where I can discuss everything from game mechanics to music scores.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor of Music Education degree and have been teaching in middle schools for a few years. My interest in gaming is self-taught, stemming from a lifelong love of interactive storytelling and strategy. I stay updated on game mechanics through forums and patch notes.
